findings.description: file_shas invokes git hash-object --stdin-paths without --no-filters. Git can execute configured clean filters selected by repository attributes. This function is reached through aidd_graphs status and refresh hashing, so the builtin-only, shell=False boundary does not establish FR-374's prohibition on project-controlled execution.
findings.evidence_limit: Identified by source inspection; no exploit or tests were executed.
findings.recommendation: Hash raw file bytes directly or explicitly disable Git filters. Add coverage for an applicable configured clean filter.

findings.description: The same hashing path measures filtered Git content rather than necessarily measuring the working-tree bytes parsed by build_with_cache. A clean filter that maps different source contents to identical output can preserve the freshness stamp and reuse outdated parsed nodes after a function is added. The lookup then appears fresh and skips refresh-on-miss, violating FR-371/FR-372.
findings.evidence_limit: The supplied baseline and focused RED/GREEN logs have matching recorded log hashes, and the current source matches the V4 receipt and adapter mirror. Those checks do not cover filtered-content hashing. No tests were rerun.
findings.recommendation: Use raw-byte hashes consistently for freshness and parse-cache reuse.
